base.golden_note: main 82f8d35 (Phase 2) on the Phase 3 fixture: the Phase 2 fixture plus the fixture-world known-crypto declaration (alone: no Phase 2 output changes) and the Phase 3 identity cases (MOONX, NEWCOIN, US100S, SAMSUNGUSD, SKHYNIX/SKHYNIXUSD, HYUNDAI/HYUNDAIUSD, US10Y, BYD, PRLX)

rules.IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED_NO_EXECUTION: An exposure without positive identity evidence is UNVERIFIED (Phase 2: CRYPTO by default, DEFAULT_CRYPTO). The coin keeps its Phase 2 record (venues, prices, volumes) and tradfi=false in the universe, and loses crypto execution identity: no engine evaluates it.
rules.PARSED_SYMBOL_TRADFI: On a venue whose symbols name the base asset only (Hyperliquid, Lighter, Variational), a symbol ending in USD yields a parsed candidate; it is tradfi evidence when the candidate is on the tradfi list or an FX pair, or when the candidate ticker has a TRADFI exposure within 20% of the contract's price. Never crypto evidence.
rules.UNVERIFIED_NOT_COUNTED_AS_CRYPTO: A DEX's count of crypto markets counts only markets admitted with crypto execution identity: unverified markets and markets that became tradfi are no longer counted.
rules.UNVERIFIED_EXPOSURE_NOT_MERGED: A price-separated UNVERIFIED exposure next to a VERIFIED_CRYPTO exposure of the same ticker is not merged into the crypto coin (contract state UNVERIFIED_EXPOSURE_NOT_ADMITTED), so the price-conflict note for it is not emitted.
rules.UNVERIFIED_LISTED_SEPARATELY: The radar publishes identity-unverified coins in coverage.unverified, not among the non-crypto (tradfi) exclusions in coverage.tradfi: unknown is not tradfi.
